The toggle cycles auto → dark → light (one click from auto is dark on a light-scheme browser) and dark mode sets the html.dark class; the case waits for that class after the click and again after the re-open, so it ends BLOCKED when dark mode did not apply or did not carry over instead of passing in the light theme.
Failure_Signals: A dark-theme logo or icon that fails to load; a raw key in the de header; a page wider than 375
Cleanup: none: currency and theme live in the case's own fresh browser context
References:
Archetype:RENDER · Technique:PW · Purpose:VISUAL
Proof (cases-that-catch-bugs.md §6), vcst 2026-10-27: PASS on the stand; FAIL on a planted mutant, an image whose source is missing, served through a local proxy that injects it into every HTML page, PASS through the same proxy without it. | Promoted: P5B-FINAL-LAYOUT-STR (2026-10-27)

Title: Catalog in dark theme with ×2 Portuguese text has no horizontal page scroll (pt, dark, ×2, 768)
Preconditions: [STRESS:TEXT] x2 repeats every visible text to twice its length after the page settles: a translation twice as long as English, the way de and pt run long. BL-UI-004: long content wraps, truncates with an ellipsis or scrolls inside its own container; the document never scrolls sideways (a data table that scrolls by itself is allowed). Dark mode sets the html.dark class; the case waits for it after the toggle and again after the re-open, so it ends BLOCKED when dark mode did not apply or did not carry over.
Steps:
[VIEWPORT] 1280x900
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/
[WAIT] networkidle
[CLICK] [data-test-id=dark-mode-toggle]
[WAIT] html.dark
[VIEWPORT] 768x1024
[NAV] {{FRONT_URL}}/pt/catalog
[WAIT] networkidle
[WAIT] html.dark
[STRESS:TEXT] x2 body
[PROBE:OVERFLOW]
Failure_Signals: A label, button or title that does not wrap and pushes the page wider than the viewport
Cleanup: none: currency and theme live in the case's own fresh browser context
